sloka: अयं च वीर सन्देहस्तिष्ठतीव ममाग्रतः ।सुमहांस्त्वत्सहायेषु हर्यृक्षेषु हरीश्वर ।। ५.३९.२४।।।।
transliteration: ayaṁ ca vīra sandehastiṣṭhatīva mamāgrataḥ ।sumahāṁstvatsahāyeṣu haryṛkṣeṣu harīśvara ।। 5.39.24।।।।

translations.english: "O heroic chief of vanaras I am doubtful as to whether vanaras and bears can extend help?
